name: True Polymorph

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic and a wisp of smoke

targets.description: a creature or nonmagical object you can see

summary: Turn a creature into another creature or an object, or an object into a creature; held for the full hour, it becomes permanent.
text: An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save; a creature form can't have a higher Challenge Rating than the target, and the target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the form's Hit Points (the spell ends when they run out). An object can become a creature no larger than it of CR 9 or lower, which obeys you and acts right after you; a creature turned into an object no larger than it remembers nothing of the time.
